purpose: Per JSON document kind: the fields expected to hold a whole-value reference, and the fields never scanned. The declaration says what is expected; the whole-value test decides. A field declared whole_value whose value fails the test falls to tier 2 and the stale declaration is reported.
field_path_note: A field path names keys from the document root, with [] for an array. orders[].id means the id key of each row of the orders array.

documents.name: orders
documents.why_verbatim: the commander's own words. O048 repaired to '(Or001 is not very readable)' would say the opposite of what the commander said.

documents.name: topics-unit
documents.why_verbatim: the commander's statements, quoted. The paper checked that all topic ids sit in ref and superseded_by, none in a statement value.
documents.why_composite: these carry the form <path>#<ID>. Both halves are resolved and the pair counts as one whole value.

documents.name: crew-manifest
documents.note: frozen by zones.json, never by a field written into it: the file declares its own frozen key and adding anything to it would edit frozen history.

quoted_span_rule.applies_to: a double-quoted span inside a JSON prose value
quoted_span_rule.why: the decisions.json D018/D021/D024 class: the same field is pilot prose in most rows and quotes the commander in a few, so no per-field rule is right for both. Freeze the quotation and it stands; rewrite it and the quotation is falsified. Reading is never suppressed -- a false finding is cured at its source or by a declared store row, never by not reading.
